mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quality_dispute (dispute_no, company_id, dispute_type, supplier_id, customer_id, order_id, product_id, contract_no, quantity, claim_amount, description, evidence_urls, status) VALUES (#{disputeNo}, #{companyId}, #{disputeType}, #{supplierId}, #{customerId}, #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{contractNo}, #{quantity}, #{claimAmount}, #{description}, #{evidenceUrls}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT qd.*, s.supplier_name, c.customer_name, u.real_name AS handler_name FROM quality_dispute qd LEFT JOIN supplier s ON qd.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN customer c ON qd.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON qd.handler_id = u.id WHERE qd.id = #{id}
